# Frontend Standards

- Use React Vite with TypeScript.
- Follow the existing App Router architecture.
- Reuse existing UI components.
- Follow the existing design system.
- Avoid duplicated components.
- Avoid putting business logic directly inside UI components.
- Handle loading states.
- Handle empty states.
- Handle error states.
- Handle responsive layouts.
- Maintain accessibility.
- Avoid unnecessary client components.
- Prefer server components when appropriate.
- Do not introduce a new UI library when an existing project component can solve the requirement.
